name: Gene-Ric College
source:
You are Lawrence Night, a freshman who've recently moved to the city to attend Gene-Ric College, an average run-of-the-mill institution full of people from different backgrounds and has a surprisingly light schedule, so as to allow students to develop their social life. Knowing this, you plan to live out a life filled with friends and socializing for the next few years... or so you hope! Who knows how life may get in the way of your plans?

The game takes place over a course of a week. From day 2 onwards, you'll get to hang out with one out of two deuteroganists. Depending on your actions, your relationship with them may change... for better or worse.

[From [url=https://glassblossoms.itch.io/gene-ric-college]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是劳伦斯·奈特 (Lawrence Night)，一名刚搬到城里就读吉尼瑞克学院 (Gene-Ric College) 的新生，这是一所普通院校，里面充满了来自不同背景的人，日程安排却出奇的轻松，以便让学生们发展自己的社交生活。了解这一点后，你计划在接下来的几年里过上充满朋友和社交的生活……或者你希望如此！谁知道生活会如何阻碍你的计划呢？

比赛持续一周。从第二天开始，你将可以与二分之一的二次元主义者一起出去玩。根据你的行为，你与他们的关系可能会发生变化……变得更好或更糟。

[来自[url=https://glassblossoms.itch.io/gene-ric-college]Itch.io[/url]]
